rv.q: His relationship with Sophie Stanton’s patient, overwhelmed Linda is particularly poignant – both comfortable in each other’s company, yet unable to relate to one another.
There’s much to cherish here, but a tighter focus might enable a deeper dive into the complex secrets that are churning through this family and their community.
Heart Wall is poignant and thought-provoking: with a tighter focus, it could deliver even more impact.
It all needs a stronger pulse and bloodflow to make for compelling drama.
A triumph – warm, witty, and deeply human.
Heart Wall is a beautifully structured, heartfelt piece that explores how death and life awkwardly co-exist in a way that feels fresh and true.
It’s just a tad too sprawling and prosaic.
